zatca.statement: E-invoices for stores in Saudi Arabia.
zatca.lead: Stores in Saudi Arabia must send signed e-invoices to ZATCA. This system creates and sends them from Retail Pro. If a step fails, it can be retried. If a store goes offline, it can still sign invoices.

highlights.label: Invoices
highlights.detail: Receive, clean up, create XML, sign, send

highlights.label: Background jobs
highlights.detail: Queue workers backed by the database

highlights.label: Offline mode
highlights.detail: Local signing, QR codes and a saved outbox

highlights.label: History
highlights.detail: A saved record of every attempt

zatca.note: Private project, shown with sample data

branches.offline: The store signs the invoice and saves it to send later.
branches.retry: A failed send is tried again. Every attempt is saved.

sfda.statement: Tracking medicine packs in Saudi Arabia.
sfda.lead: The SFDA tracks every medicine pack from warehouse to patient. This system reports each movement from inside the Retail Pro Prism point of sale, so staff can keep serving customers. If the SFDA's answer is unclear, it stops instead of reporting a pack twice.

highlights.label: Windows service
highlights.detail: .NET service with local SQLite storage

highlights.label: Point of sale
highlights.detail: Prism plugin for transactions and stock matching

highlights.label: Scanner
highlights.detail: Reads the GS1 DataMatrix code on each pack

highlights.label: Safe sending
highlights.detail: Safe retries, and a clear result when the answer is unknown

sfda.note: Private project, shown with sample data

branches.unknown: The result is marked as unknown, so the pack isn't reported twice.

shots: SFDA RSD transactions inside the Prism plugin

raneem.statement: Gift orders, from checkout to the door.
raneem.lead: Customers pick a gift and a delivery time. Staff prepare and check it. A driver delivers it and confirms with a photo and a one-time code. One platform for customers, shoppers, drivers and staff, in Arabic and English.

highlights.label: Store
highlights.detail: Gifts, bouquet builder, gift cards and subscriptions

highlights.label: Backend
highlights.detail: .NET services for web and mobile

highlights.label: Operations
highlights.detail: Orders, preparation, delivery and stock

highlights.label: Mobile prototypes
highlights.detail: Expo apps for drivers and personal shoppers

raneem.note: Private project, shown with demo data
shots: Operations console showing the work due today

strata.lead: Strata is the league site for the GameReplays.org Command & Conquer: Generals community. It has ladders, player profiles, match history and stats. In October 2026, 954 people were on the site at the same time.

highlights.label: Competition
highlights.detail: Overall and seasonal ladders

highlights.label: Data
highlights.detail: Scheduled imports and queue workers for match history

highlights.label: Stats
highlights.detail: Matchups, map win rates and performance graphs

strata.note: Live site, built with the GameReplays team

items.title: One step at a time.
items.body: If a step fails, only that step runs again. Nothing before it is lost.

items.title: If unsure, stop.
items.body: If a system doesn't know whether something worked, it should say so, not guess.

items.title: Done means delivered.
items.body: An order isn't done when it leaves the shop. It's done when a photo and a code confirm delivery.

items.title: Arabic and English, equally.
items.body: Both languages come from the same components, in products people use today.
